note: Benralizumab is a biologic medication administered by subcutaneous injection only. It is NOT available in oral pill form in any formulation or manufacturer variant in the US market.
clarification: Benralizumab has no pill, tablet, or capsule formulations. It is exclusively available as a parenteral injection for treatment of eosinophilic asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps.
